This surah is Meccan.

In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

{1} The Exalted says, rebuking His servants for being preoccupied with what they were created for: the worship of Him alone, without partner, knowing Him, turning to Him in repentance, and giving His love precedence over everything else. ﴿Rivalry in worldly gain distracts you﴾: from that mentioned purpose. ﴿Rivalry in worldly gain﴾: the object of the rivalry is not mentioned, so that it includes everything people compete over and boast of: [competition in] wealth, children, supporters, armies, servants, status, and other things sought for the purpose of outdoing one another, and not for the sake of Allah's countenance.

{2} Your heedlessness, your amusement, and your preoccupation continued until ﴿you visited the graves﴾. Then the veil will be lifted for you, but after it is too late to make amends. The words ﴿until you visited the graves﴾ indicate that the barzakh (the intermediate realm between death and resurrection) is an abode whose purpose is to pass on to the Hereafter, because Allah called them visitors and did not call them residents. This points to resurrection and to recompense for deeds in an everlasting abode that does not perish.

{3–6} For this reason He threatened them: ﴿No! You are going to know. Then, no! You are going to know. No! If you knew with certainty of knowledge﴾; that is, if you knew what lies ahead of you with a knowledge that reaches the hearts, rivalry would not have distracted you, and you would have hastened to righteous deeds. But the lack of true knowledge has brought you to what you see. ﴿You will surely see the Hellfire﴾; that is, you will certainly arrive at the Resurrection, and you will see the Hellfire that Allah has prepared for the disbelievers.

{7} ﴿Then you will surely see it with the eye of certainty﴾; that is, you will see it with your own eyes, as He said: ﴿And the criminals will see the Fire and be certain that they are about to fall into it, and they will find no escape from it.﴾

{8} ﴿Then you will surely be questioned that Day about the pleasure﴾ with which you were blessed in the life of this world: did you give thanks for it, fulfil Allah's right in it, and refrain from using it to disobey Him, so that He would give you a greater and better bounty in return? Or were you deceived by it, failing to give thanks, and perhaps even using it to commit sins, so that He would punish you for that? He said, the Exalted: ﴿And on the Day those who disbelieved are exposed to the Fire: "You squandered your good things in your worldly life and enjoyed them. So today you will be recompensed with the punishment of humiliation..."﴾ and the verse continues.
